Nina (Finance): Morning 11 Brightleaf invoice BL-209 failed auto-charge at 09:14. Stripe decline_code shows `card_not_supported`. Any quick ops take?
Owen (BillingOps): Looking now. Card on file ends 1111 exp 09/25, network mismatch flagged by processor. No backup payment method. No prior dunning.
Mark (AE): Customer is in a growth trial, big upcoming deployment. Hard cutoff would kill the PoC. Can we do a limited grace?
CS-Bot: Customer message via support form: "AP uses virtual cards via P-Card provider; their provider is blocking this vendor. Can we accept wire or ACH?"
Owen (BillingOps): Suggested flow: 1) schedule retries at 12h and 24h, 2) send one-time secure pay link, 3) offer wire/ACH and allow 48h grace for service. For virtual card issues, manual retry after card rotation often works.
Nina (Finance): Approve 48h grace for Brightleaf given PoC status. Owen, send secure pay link + wire template over encrypted email. Do not paste routing in Slack.
stripe-bot: Event posted: payment_intent.payment_failed {"code":"card_not_supported","amount":"240000"}
Owen (BillingOps): Wire template (SENSITIVE - sent via encrypted email): Bank: Redwood Inference, LLC; Reference: BL-209 / Brightleaf. NOTE: request full routing via secure channel.
Mark (AE): I'll nudge their AP and ask them to rotate the virtual card. CC me on outreach so I can escalate to procurement if needed.
CS-Bot: AP asked: please include company TIN on invoice for remittance.
Nina (Finance): I'll send TIN via secure email to their AP and to billing ops. Do not publish in channel.
Owen (BillingOps): Updated invoice BL-209 status to "awaiting payment - grace 48h". Scheduled retries and added internal note: "virtual card issue; customer asked for wire/ACH; AP to rotate card".
Mark (AE): Customer replied: rotating card now, will try payment in ~30m and confirm.
stripe-bot: Charge succeeded (manual) amount 2400.00 USD - invoice BL-209
Nina (Finance): Payment received. Great work. Action: billing ops to annotate account to recommend adding fallback ACH and to record the AP contact. Closing thread.
